Six abilities provide a quick description of every        16–17  +3
creature’s physical and mental characteristics:
                                                          18–19  +4
• Strength, measuring physical power
• Dexterity, measuring agility                            20–21  +5
• Constitution, measuring endurance
• Intelligence, measuring reasoning and memory            22–23  +6
• Wisdom, measuring perception and insight
• Charisma, measuring force of personality                24–25  +7

Is a character muscle-bound and insightful? Brilliant  26–27  +8
and charming? Nimble and hardy? Ability scores
define these qualities—a creature’s assets as well as     28–29  +9
weaknesses.
